name: Puppeteer
summary: Node.js library to control Chrome/Firefox over the DevTools Protocol or WebDriver BiDi, v25.19.0: guides (launch/connect, locators and selectors, request interception, screenshots/PDF, headless modes, Docker, configuration), full puppeteer API reference, @puppeteer/browsers 3.3.0 CLI/API (Chrome for Testing downloads), troubleshooting, release notes.
coverage: Every English Markdown page under docs/ at the puppeteer-v25.19.0 tag: 25 guides, FAQ, troubleshooting, WebDriver BiDi support page, supported-browsers version table, examples, contributing; the generated API reference (661 pages, content/api-reference) and the @puppeteer/browsers API reference (55 pages, content/browsers-api-reference); the packages/browsers README; GitHub release notes for puppeteer, puppeteer-core 25.19.0 and @puppeteer/browsers 3.3.0.
gaps: Only the release notes for 25.19.0 itself are included, not the full CHANGELOG history (packages/puppeteer-core/CHANGELOG.md at the tag has it).

Links inside pages are pptr.dev site-relative (../api/puppeteer.configuration, https://pptr.dev/api/...). The API folders were renamed to api-reference/ and browsers-api-reference/ for search classification, so relative links to ../api/... and ../browsers-api/... do not resolve locally.
Images (docs/assets/overview.png/.svg) dropped; Docusaurus admonitions (:::note) and code-block meta (npm2yarn, title=) left as-is.
content/browsers/README.md duplicates the first part of content/browsers-api-reference/index.md (the site builds that index from the README plus the API tables).
Chrome-side documentation (command-line switches, DevTools Protocol, headless, ChromeDriver) is not here; it is in the sibling set `chrome`.
The pptr.dev website versioned copies and the website/ build files are not included; the tag's docs/ folder is the source of the current site.
notes: Puppeteer's docs live as Markdown in the main repo; docs/api and docs/browsers-api are generated by API Extractor from the source at that tag, so they match 25.19.0 exactly. Renamed docs/api -> content/api-reference and docs/browsers-api -> content/browsers-api-reference so search classifies them as API reference. The tag has no versioned_docs or translations. No build-time placeholders found. Bundled browsers at this tag (packages/puppeteer-core/src/revisions.ts): Chrome for Testing 158.0.8127.88, chrome-headless-shell 158.0.8127.88, Firefox stable_161.0. Also saved browsers-v3.3.0 release notes since @puppeteer/browsers was bumped to 3.3.0 in this release.
